title: Split src/mcp.rs into owning modules and move the shared error rendering out of the MCP transport
outcome: Split src/mcp.rs into owning modules and move the shared error rendering out of the MCP transport
acceptance: src/mcp.rs is split into owning modules so it stays well under the source-file size limit, with the size test passing unchanged
The shared error rendering used by CLI JSON and MCP (store_error_value and the remedy twins) lives in a transport-neutral module, so the verbs layer no longer depends on crate::mcp outside tests
The tools/list schemas and every CLI and MCP output are unchanged, shown by the existing tests passing

completion.summary: Split MCP into owning arguments, tools and tests modules; moved shared error envelopes and remedy twins to transport-neutral rendering. Preserved all schemas and CLI/MCP outputs; size limit unchanged.
